source_citation: Pous, Carton and Lazure (2004), Hydrology and circulation in the Strait of Hormuz and the Gulf of Oman: Results from the GOGP99 Experiment, part 2, JGR Oceans 109, doi:10.1029/2003JC002146.

core_definition: Depth of maximum salinity of the Persian Gulf Water core; not a velocity maximum, top, bottom, or physical current thickness.

records.geographic_scope: Strait of Hormuz and northwestern Gulf of Oman shelf before the R18-R17 descending transition; exact section-wise assignments and coordinates are not reconstructed.
records.range_interpretation: Author-described downstream increase in salinity-core depth across the strait and shelf reach; a spatial description, not thickness, uncertainty, sampled extrema or annual range.
records.source_locator: Section 3.2 paragraph 15, first two sentences after the R12 exclusion.

records.geographic_scope: R18-R17 descent from the northwestern Gulf of Oman shelf to the detached PGW core near neutral buoyancy; not a uniform downstream or entire-current depth.
records.source_locator: Section 3.2 paragraph 15, descent between R18 and R17.

post_R17.R15_exception: Source reports a slightly shallower core at R15; do not make a uniform 200m layer or a new independent depth observation.

qualifications: These rows transcribe distinct regional source descriptions from the same GOGP99 campaign, not new independent casts or a reconstructed continuous profile.
The 70-120m span is depth below the sea surface, not a 50m layer thickness; no midpoint or uncertainty is invented.

The regional narrative near 200m and the existing approximately220m thermohaline-core reference use different spatial summaries; preserve both without treating their difference as uncertainty or a seasonal range.
The downstream less-than30m shoaling is a relative change bound over a source-described reach; it cannot supply either absolute endpoint or an annual range.

Core depth and previously reported half-salinity-contrast core thickness do not locate a symmetric top/bottom. No geographic station coordinates, width join, physical bottom, whole-route profile, seasonal extrema or volume is inferred.
